name: Where is Starlingdive
summary:
She went off the air and off the record. Prove she never withdrew.

It is 2008. A college radio DJ who goes by the handle starlingdive has vanished. The conduct office calls it a voluntary withdrawal. You are the archive temp assigned to close the file by Friday.

Search a message board, read sealed conduct files, compare candid photos, and match every handle to a real person. Rebuild the radio scene's hidden hierarchy to find out why students keep disappearing.

Who Is Starlingdive? is a browser-based deduction mystery about identities and institutional rot.
